'''Kedler''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] in command of a [[Imperial Navy/Legends|navy]] relief force sent to [[Sellasas]] after the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Siege of Sellasas|siege]] there.
